name: My Dream Idol
source:
You used up some meager savings and started up a showbiz company on your own as its managing director. You've been searching for an idol cadet to recruit but you're not having much luck finding one. 

But one day, you make a fateful encounter. The boy says his name is Sooya. 

He's the future star you had been seeking out for so long. You get him to work on things like developing his showbiz abilities, auditioning, appearing in commercials, releasing his debut album...

Busy days working with Sooya have just begun...

[Translation of [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ152966.html]DL Site story summary[/url].]
translation:
你拿出为数不多的积蓄，独自创办了一家演艺公司，并担任总经理。你一直在寻找可以招募的偶像练习生，却始终没有遇到合适的人选。

直到某天，一场命中注定的邂逅降临了。那个男孩说，他叫Sooya。

他正是你寻觅已久的未来之星。你开始安排他磨炼演艺技能、参加试镜、出演广告、发行首张专辑…

与Sooya一起忙碌的日子，就此开始…

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ152966.html]DLsite剧情简介[/url]。]
